en.h1: How to download your Pagatelia invoices
en.intro: Pagatelia builds up one invoice per period for tolls and car parks. Recovering the full history means downloading them one by one.

es.h1: Cómo descargar tus facturas de Pagatelia
es.intro: Pagatelia acumula una factura por periodo de peajes y parkings. Recuperar el histórico completo significa descargarlas una a una.
